verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at docs.trychannel3.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) indexing the docs. Channel3 also publishes an agent-oriented agents.md developer page, an auth.md, and serves its doc pages as raw .md (MCP, SDK, CLI, pricing, API reference), so an agent can be pointed straight at machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs, and a discoverable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404).
